title: Beyond Accuracy: What Language-Subspace Interventions Capture, Remove, and Improve
abstract: arXiv:2611.05278v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language-subspace interventions aim to improve multilingual reasoning by suppressing language-related components in mid-layer activations. Using MATH and MGSM across four open-weight LLMs, we ask three questions: do estimated language subspaces capture translation-associated variation? Does projecting them out remove language information? And do they improve accuracy without compromising response language? For the first question, we build subspaces using the existing Mean-SVD construction and our DiffPCA. Both capture substantial translation-associated variation and show similar patterns across model depth. For the second, we project out each subspace and train linear probes to classify language from the projected activations. The probes still identify language almost perfectly, showing that neither subspace exhaustively captures language information. translated_title: 超越准确率：语言子空间干预捕捉、移除与改进了什么
translated_abstract: 语言子空间干预旨在通过抑制中间层激活中与语言相关的成分来提升多语言推理能力。我们在四个开放权重大语言模型上使用 MATH 和 MGSM 数据集，提出三个问题：估计出的语言子空间是否捕捉了与翻译相关的变化？将这些子空间投影去除后是否能移除语言信息？它们能否在不损害响应语言的前提下提升准确率？针对第一个问题，我们使用现有的 Mean-SVD 构建方法以及我们提出的 DiffPCA 来构建子空间，两者都捕捉到了大量与翻译相关的变化，并在不同模型深度上呈现出相似的模式。针对第二个问题，我们将每个子空间投影出去，并训练线性探针从投影后的激活中对语言进行分类，结果显示探针仍能几乎完美地识别出语言，这表明两种子空间都无法穷尽地捕捉语言信息。针对第三个问题，我们在 Qwen2.5-7B 上评估了多种干预配置……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现基于 Mean-SVD 和 DiffPCA 构建的语言子空间虽能捕捉翻译相关的变化，但投影去除后语言信息仍可被线性探针近乎完美地识别，说明现有语言子空间干预并不能穷尽地移除语言信息。
en_tdlr: The study shows that language subspaces built via Mean-SVD and DiffPCA capture substantial translation-associated variation but fail to exhaustively remove language information, as linear probes can still identify language almost perfectly from the projected activations.
